correctness.rationale: The source RESULT.md gives independent N~Pois(epsilon), M~Pois(1-epsilon/2) and X=N+2M for 0<epsilon<2, hence a nonnegative two-atom Levy measure, mean 2 and variance 4-epsilon. The radius lies strictly between 1 and 2, so the CLOSED one-sigma interval contains exactly integer totals 1,2,3. Independently expanding Poisson coefficients gives exp(-1-epsilon/2)(1+3epsilon/2+epsilon^3/6), which tends to e^-1 and bounds the global infinitely divisible infimum. Independently re-evaluated epsilon=0.01 numerically. No lower bound/equality is proved.
